SELECT MIN(n.name) AS voicing_actress, MIN(t.title) AS kung_fu_panda
FROM movie_info AS mi
JOIN info_type AS it ON it.id = mi.info_type_id
JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON mc.movie_id = mi.movie_id
JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = mi.movie_id
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.movie_id = mi.movie_id
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
JOIN role_type AS rt ON rt.id = ci.role_id
JOIN aka_name AS an ON an.person_id = n.id
JOIN char_name AS chn ON chn.id = ci.person_role_id
WHERE mi.info IS NOT NULL
  AND it.info = 'release dates'
  AND cn.country_code = '[us]'
  AND mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
  AND (mc.note LIKE '%(USA)%' OR mc.note LIKE '%(worldwide)%')
  AND (mi.info LIKE 'Japan:%2007%' OR mi.info LIKE 'USA:%2008%')
  AND ci.note = '(voice)'
  AND n.gender = 'f'
  AND n.name LIKE '%Angel%'
  AND rt.role = 'actress'
  AND t.production_year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008
  AND t.title LIKE '%Kung%Fu%Panda%'
